title: Shepherdhood of Christ
definition: The shepherdhood of Christ means that Jesus leads, feeds, protects, seeks, restores, and lays down His life for His sheep.
summary: Jesus is the Good Shepherd who knows and keeps His people.
christFocus: Christ shepherds His people with sacrificial love, truth, protection, and care.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He knows His sheep, calls them by name, leads them, protects them, and lays down His life for them.

His shepherdhood includes both tenderness and authority. He seeks the lost, restores the wandering, feeds His flock with truth, and keeps His people secure.

All earthly shepherding must reflect His character and remain under His rule.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel vulnerable, lost, or uncared for. The shepherdhood of Christ matters because He personally knows and keeps His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen for the Shepherd's voice in Scripture. Follow Him, return when you wander, and care for others with His shepherd heart.
